policy: Localized pages must receive recorded native-language commercial review before new or materially changed commercial copy is approved for indexation; localized legal copy also requires native legal review.
approval_requirements: reviewer language and relevant commercial or legal qualification
Search Console demand evidence or an explicit evidence-unavailable hold
fallback_policy: English fallback pages remain noindex,follow until translated content is materially different from the English source.
legal_page_policy: All localized privacy, terms and legal pages remain noindex,follow until a native legal reviewer is recorded. English legal pages remain the x-default source.
commercial_review_status: No blanket native approval is inferred from language completeness. Existing pages remain a legacy inventory; new or materially changed localized commercial pages cannot be marked approved without a complete review-register row. Current certificates and contractual terms remain controlling.
search_demand_policy: Create or expand localized landing pages only when Search Console query/page/country evidence or documented buyer demand supports distinct intent. Absence of data is a hold, not proof of no demand.
